cd_pairs.note: flow that leaves at the split returns at the re-entry; the net is the C-D road's own exchange with the streets it serves, fixed by the mainline counts (no ramp of the C-D road itself is in the scenario)

balance_rules.note: skipped stations stay in the observations and are scored; an ignored detector's ramp closes its bracket by conservation; with carry_residuals false a bracket's unexplained change is recorded in bracket_residuals and not passed on
